remarks: Welcome to urban living at its finest! This beautifully renovated condo offers modern comfort and convenience, with easy access to major amenities and attractions. Step into a sleek and stylish living space featuring contemporary finishes, molding throughout, and high-quality materials, creating a modern and inviting space. Situated just minutes away from the highway, Norwalk hospital, train station and an array of restaurants and shops, this condo offers the ultimate in convenience and accessibility. For an extra fee you could get a private garage however, there are plenty of parking for you and your guests. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this renovated condo in a prime location! HIGHEST AND BEST DUE MONDAY 8/4 AT 8 PM.
